issue_title: [bug] rsvd wastes ~25% of the rank budget: Ĉ = P·A·P·B·P needs only 3 of its 4 sketched subspaces
issue_body:
## What's wrong

`RandomizedSVDTransform.basis` ([strategy/transforms.py](https://github.com/zeokin/Cuda-Compute-OSS/blob/main/strategy/transforms.py)) splits the M-column budget **evenly across four subspaces** — col(A), row(A), col(B), row(B) — and its docstring claims all four "must be captured for the product". That is not true, and it costs accuracy.

The subspace reconstruction is `Ĉ = Q (QᵀAQ)(QᵀBQ) Qᵀ = P·A·P·B·P` with the orthogonal projector `P = QQᵀ`. Reducing that product:

```
P A = A   iff  col(A) ⊆ range(Q)
A P = A   iff  row(A) ⊆ range(Q)
B P = B   iff  row(B) ⊆ range(Q)
=> P A P B P = A·P·B·P = A·B·P = A·B
```

So the **necessary-and-sufficient** set is **{col(A), row(A), row(B)} — three spaces, not four**. col(A) and row(B) are always required; of the remaining pair only **one** of {row(A), col(B)} is needed (an alternative reduction `P B = B` swaps row(A) for col(B)). The current code sketches **both** row(A) and col(B), so a full **1/4 of the rank budget is spent on a subspace that never affects the result**, starving the three that do.

## Impact (device-independent, verified in numpy)

Exact rank-`r` A and B (`n=200`, `r=10`), reconstruction rel-error vs `A@B`:

| M | 4-way split (current) | 3-way split {colA,rowA,rowB} |
|---|-----------------------|------------------------------|
| 3r = 30 | **0.74** (useless)   | **2e-14** (exact) |
| 33      | **0.42**             | 2e-15 (exact) |
| 4r = 40 | 9e-15 (exact)        | 2e-15 (exact) |

Exact recovery of a rank-`r` product needs `M ≳ 4r` today where `M ≳ 3r` suffices — **33% more rank (and compute) for the same result**, and materially worse accuracy at any fixed `M < 4r`. A projector test with exact SVD subspaces confirms the algebra: dropping col(B) leaves rel-error at 1e-15, while dropping row(B), col(A), or row(A) each blows it up to ~0.9 — except that dropping row(A) stays exact **iff** col(B) is kept, confirming exactly one of {row(A), col(B)} is redundant.

On the GPU pipeline (rank-16 product, `n=512`, fp32) the fixed 3-way rsvd reaches `rel_err 7e-6` at `M=3r=48`.

## Suggested fix

Split the budget three ways over {col(A), row(A), row(B)}:

```python
base, rem = divmod(m, 3)
widths = [base + (1 if i < rem else 0) for i in range(3)]
# col(A): A Ω ; row(A): Aᵀ Ω ; row(B): Bᵀ Ω   (drop the col(B) = B Ω sketch)
```

Total sketch width stays `m`, so `basis_flops` (`2n²m + 2nm²`) is unchanged and the FLOP accounting stays correct; only the accuracy-per-rank improves. All existing `test_rsvd_*` / `test_exact_when_m_equals_n` tests still pass.

This is distinct from the open rank-`m` reporting issues (#60/#61/#62): those are about *reporting* the M value; this is about the *subspace selection and 4-way division* inside `basis`.
